subject: ANH
note: Bài nghe bổ sung cho Tiếng Anh 6 - Unit 6 (Global Success).

questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi
questions.audio_text: A: Tet is coming, Mai. What does your family do before Tet? B: We clean the house and decorate it with peach blossoms. My mother buys a kumquat tree at the flower market. A: Do you help her? B: Yes, I help her clean the house and water the flowers.

sub_questions.q: What does Mai's family decorate the house with?
Where does Mai's mother buy a kumquat tree?

questions.explain: Câu 1: gia đình Mai trang trí nhà bằng hoa đào ('decorate it with peach blossoms'). Câu 2: mẹ mua cây quất ở chợ hoa ('at the flower market').

questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi
questions.audio_text: A: Happy New Year, Grandma! I wish you good health and a long life. B: Thank you, dear. You are a good boy. Here is a red envelope for you. A: Wow, lucky money! Thank you very much, Grandma. B: I wish you good luck and good marks at school this year.

sub_questions.q: What does the boy wish his grandma?
options: B. Good health and a long life

sub_questions.q: What does Grandma give the boy?

questions.explain: Câu 1: cậu bé chúc bà sức khỏe và sống lâu ('good health and a long life'). Câu 2: bà tặng bao lì xì đỏ ('a red envelope').

questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi
questions.audio_text: A: What are you doing, Dad? B: I am making sticky rice cakes with your mother. We use sticky rice, beans and meat. A: How long do you cook the cakes? B: For about ten hours. Tomorrow we will give some cakes to our neighbours. A: That is a nice Tet tradition.

sub_questions.q: What does Dad use to make sticky rice cakes?
options: A. Sticky rice, beans and meat

sub_questions.q: How long do they cook the cakes?

questions.explain: Câu 1: nguyên liệu là gạo nếp, đậu và thịt ('sticky rice, beans and meat'). Câu 2: bánh được luộc khoảng mười tiếng ('about ten hours').

questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi
questions.audio_text: A: Where will your family go on the first day of Tet, Phong? B: In the morning, we will visit our grandparents and wish them a happy new year. A: What about the afternoon? B: We will go to the pagoda to pray for luck and peace. A: That sounds great.

sub_questions.q: What will Phong's family do in the morning?
Why will they go to the pagoda?
options: C. To pray for luck and peace

questions.explain: Câu 1: buổi sáng họ thăm ông bà ('visit our grandparents'). Câu 2: họ đi chùa để cầu may mắn và bình an ('pray for luck and peace').

questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi
questions.audio_text: A: What should we do at Tet, Miss Lan? B: You should visit your teachers and wish them a happy new year. A: And what shouldn't we do? B: You shouldn't say bad words or break things. People believe it brings bad luck. A: I see. Thank you, Miss Lan.

sub_questions.q: What should students do at Tet?
options: C. Sweep the house on the first day

sub_questions.q: Why shouldn't people say bad words at Tet?
options: B. Because teachers do not like it
C. Because people believe it brings bad luck

questions.explain: Câu 1: học sinh nên thăm thầy cô ('visit your teachers'). Câu 2: không nên nói lời xui vì người ta tin nó mang lại điều không may ('brings bad luck').

questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi
questions.audio_text: A: Look at the calendar, Hoa. Tet holiday starts next Friday. B: Really? Then we have a week off. Would you like some sticky rice cake? My mother made it this morning. A: Yes, please. Is there any tea? B: Yes, there is some green tea in the pot. Let me get you a cup.

sub_questions.q: Would Hoa like some sticky rice cake? What does the answer tell us?
options: A. Hoa says yes, she would
B. Hoa says no, she is full

questions.explain: Câu 1: kì nghỉ Tết bắt đầu vào thứ Sáu tuần sau ('starts next Friday'). Câu 2: Hoa trả lời 'Yes, please' nên cô ấy muốn ăn bánh chưng.
